messages.plaintextBody:
Rachel,

Attaching our first draft of the Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement. The key liability and protection positions are: warrantor liability cap at 100% of the Investment Amount (clause 9.2); a general claims time limit of 18 months from Completion (clause 9.5); a de minimis at 15% of the Threshold and a Threshold (basket) of GBP 120,000; founder non-compete of 24 months and non-solicitation of 18 months (clause 11); and a customary unqualified Material Adverse Change condition at clause 3.1.7.

Subject to contract and to DD. Look forward to your mark-up.

Best,
James

messages.subject: RE: Project Lumen - SPA: our first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up is attached. The headline movements, which our client regards as essential:

- Warrantor cap reduced from 100% to 50% of the Investment Amount. A first-round-style 100% cap is not acceptable for founders rolling on.
- General survival period cut from 18 to 12 months. We won't have the founders exposed for longer than a single audit cycle.
- Founder non-compete cut from 24 to 12 months - 24 is unenforceable on these facts and we'd expect a court to agree.
- De minimis raised from 15% to 20% of the Threshold, and the Threshold itself raised from GBP 120,000 to GBP 200,000.
- The MAC condition at 3.1.7 needs narrowing: it must carve out general economic and market conditions, changes in law, and pandemic / force majeure events. As drafted it is far too broad and effectively gives Crestview a walk-away right.

We've also broadened the good-leaver protections and softened the IP knowledge qualifiers. Happy to talk these through.

Rachel

Rachel Hargrove | Partner | Hargrove & Associates LLP

messages.plaintextBody:
Rachel,

Having taken client instructions, here is where we can get to:

- Cap: we'll come off 100% but not to 50%. We can land at 75% of the Investment Amount.
- Survival: 12 months is too short for a business of this profile. We'll move to 15 months.
- Non-compete: we accept 24 is on the long side and will give to 18 months. Non-solicitation stays at 18.
- De minimis: meet in the middle at 17.5% of the Threshold; Threshold at GBP 150,000.
- MAC: the condition stays as drafted. Crestview is not prepared to add carve-outs - this is a standard pre-completion MAC and we don't accept it operates as a free option.

If that package works we can turn an execution version quickly.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

James,

Understood. We're disappointed not to get any MAC carve-out, but our client will accept 3.1.7 as drafted to get the deal closed. On that basis everything is agreed. Please send the execution version and we'll arrange founder signatures.

Rachel


On Tue, Mar 5, 2024 at 2:30 PM, James Osei <james.osei@whitfieldcarter.com> wrote:
Rachel,

On the MAC, the client's position is final: clause 3.1.7 stays unqualified, with no carve-outs. Crestview is comfortable that the condition is fair on these facts and won't be adding economic-conditions or change-in-law exclusions.

Everything else is agreed: cap 75%, survival 15 months, non-compete 18 months, non-solicitation 18 months, de minimis 17.5% and Threshold GBP 150,000. We'll prepare the execution version on that basis and send it across with the Investor Rights Agreement and the side letter.

Best,
James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.


On Fri, Mar 1, 2024 at 11:05 AM, Rachel Hargrove <rachel.hargrove@hargroveassoc.com> wrote:
James,

That package is largely acceptable: we'll take the 75% cap, 15-month survival, 18-month non-compete and the de minimis at 17.5% / GBP 150,000.

The one point we can't simply concede is the MAC. We don't need the full list, but at a minimum 3.1.7 should carve out general economic and market conditions and changes in law that affect the sector generally rather than the company specifically. Please put that to your client once more.

Rachel


On Tue, Feb 27, 2024 at 3:20 PM, James Osei <james.osei@whitfieldcarter.com> wrote:
Rachel,

Having taken client instructions, here is where we can get to:

- Cap: we'll come off 100% but not to 50%. We can land at 75% of the Investment Amount.
- Survival: 12 months is too short for a business of this profile. We'll move to 15 months.
- Non-compete: we accept 24 is on the long side and will give to 18 months. Non-solicitation stays at 18.
- De minimis: meet in the middle at 17.5% of the Threshold; Threshold at GBP 150,000.
- MAC: the condition stays as drafted. Crestview is not prepared to add carve-outs - this is a standard pre-completion MAC and we don't accept it operates as a free option.

If that package works we can turn an execution version quickly.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.


On Mon, Feb 19, 2024 at 4:40 PM, Rachel Hargrove <rachel.hargrove@hargroveassoc.com> wrote:
James,

Our mark-up is attached. The headline movements, which our client regards as essential:

- Warrantor cap reduced from 100% to 50% of the Investment Amount. A first-round-style 100% cap is not acceptable for founders rolling on.
- General survival period cut from 18 to 12 months. We won't have the founders exposed for longer than a single audit cycle.
- Founder non-compete cut from 24 to 12 months - 24 is unenforceable on these facts and we'd expect a court to agree.
- De minimis raised from 15% to 20% of the Threshold, and the Threshold itself raised from GBP 120,000 to GBP 200,000.
- The MAC condition at 3.1.7 needs narrowing: it must carve out general economic and market conditions, changes in law, and pandemic / force majeure events. As drafted it is far too broad and effectively gives Crestview a walk-away right.

We've also broadened the good-leaver protections and softened the IP knowledge qualifiers. Happy to talk these through.

Rachel

Rachel Hargrove | Partner | Hargrove & Associates LLP


On Mon, Feb 5, 2024 at 10:30 AM, James Osei <james.osei@whitfieldcarter.com> wrote:
Rachel,

Attaching our first draft of the Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement. The key liability and protection positions are: warrantor liability cap at 100% of the Investment Amount (clause 9.2); a general claims time limit of 18 months from Completion (clause 9.5); a de minimis at 15% of the Threshold and a Threshold (basket) of GBP 120,000; founder non-compete of 24 months and non-solicitation of 18 months (clause 11); and a customary unqualified Material Adverse Change condition at clause 3.1.7.

Subject to contract and to DD. Look forward to your mark-up.

Best,
James
